content: Malformed shader source can crash glslang/shaderc's compiler itself (not just fail cleanly) on some inputs; separately, invalid-but-syntactically-parseable SPIR-V that skips spirv-val can crash vkCreateShaderModule/vkCreateGraphicsPipelines inside the driver (documented crashes in RADV and other drivers) rather than returning a clean VkResult error. Validation layers do not catch every case that later crashes the driver -- spirv-val (SPIRV-Tools) must run explicitly as its own gate, separate from and prior to invoking any Vulkan pipeline-creation call.
